card.name: Words just before the word dose
card.fires_on: The word or word piece right before an expected 'dose', such as 'Recommended' + D, 'missed', 'single', 'a' in dosing instructions. It also fires on the D that starts 'Dose' in dose-reduction tables.

modes.label: Before dose
modes.description: Modifier word just before 'dose' in missed-dose or single-dose instructions.
modes.example: administer the<< missed>> dose the following week by Day 1

modes.label: Start of Dose
modes.description: The first letter or piece of 'Dose' when the word is split, as in tables of dose changes.
modes.example: 1 st Dose Reduction 2 nd Dose Reduction 3 rd<< D>>ose Reduction 1,600
